contribution.position: Holding my earlier position: no new evidence has appeared addressing the retry-storm failure mode behind both sev2 incidents in artifact:incident-log, and artifact:test-report's 412 green tests still do not exercise it. I also flag ops's claim: the cited artifact:restore-test-2026-08 does not exist in the artifact list, and artifact:ops-runbook states a restore has never been tested — so the 'proven rollback path' is unsupported. Until retry behavior under downstream failure is tested and rollback evidence is real, reliability evidence is still missing.
